rationale: All runs are feasible with wide headroom, so only T_eff matters. Period (0.45 floor), setup margins (0.4) and RC pessimism (cap213) are maxed; signoff slack is the margin plus an estimate-to-signoff gap that grew as wires lengthened (density 55/41/31%: gap 0.129/0.143/0.153 ns). ABC buffering/sizing has no effect under AREA 3. Setting 1: best run at the 25% density floor (util 20, delta 5). Setting 2: same plus ocs_blitter's repair recipe (no post-GRT design repair, slew 22%, cap 29%), whose gap at 55% density (0.139, despite a lower GRT margin) beat R2-2's 0.129 at equal density.
